semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Maxmold Polymer provides specialized sealing solutions crucial for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Maxmold Polymer specializes in high-performance sealing solutions, offering O-rings and gaskets designed to meet stringent semiconductor process requirements. Their products, including the Katon® brand, are known for low particle size and high heat resistance, supporting critical equipment in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Fluororubber and perfluoro O-rings compliant with AS568 and JIS B 2401 standards
